inscriptions.name: Rapid Advance
inscriptions.effect:
The wielder's troop gains a 7.0% boost to combo attack damage dealt.
Whenever their troop deals combo attack damage, it has a 65% chance to ignore 50% of the hit troop's Defense. This effect can trigger up to 3 times per turn. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

inscriptions.name: Bold Ambitions
inscriptions.effect:
The wielder's troop gains a 7.0% boost to combo attack damage dealt. 
Combo attacks launched by their troop are 20% more likely to trigger effects triggered by launching a basic attack.
When their troop launches basic attacks, it has a 10% chance to gain 10 Rage per second for the next 3 seconds. This effect can trigger up to 1 time per turn and can stack up to 3 times.
